findings.passage: “Having confidence that our elections are fair, accurately counted, and transparent should be a priority for every single voter in our state,” said Rep. Melotik. “Voting is a constitutional right we all must protect no matter what party.”
findings.note: Press release issued by his office after a floor vote on a package of election bills. Package as described in the release: early processing of absentee ballots, ID for all indefinitely confined voters, no ballot curing, text alerts for absentee ballots, extra checks against non-citizen voting, protections for ballots of seniors and assisted-living residents.
subjects: ID for indefinitely confined absentee voters

findings.passage: “Our constituents want and deserve consistency and to improve election integrity, and we’re happy to deliver these reforms,” said Rep. Melotik. “It’s time for Governor Evers to listen to the will of the people and make these bills law.”
findings.note: Same release; asks the Governor to sign the election bills.
